title: The Ledger-Goblins
description: Justin's original counting-folk: tiny goblins who audit every coin and never let a sum go wrong.

title: The Gear-Goblins
description: Justin's original machine-tenders: small folk who keep engines running and punish neglected oil.

title: The Seed-Goblins
description: Justin's original garden-folk: tiny planters who remember every seed ever sown in their soil.

title: The Ink-Goblins
description: Justin's original scribe-folk: goblins who live in inkwells and correct spelling while the writer sleeps.

title: The Hearth-Goblins
description: Justin's original fire-tenders: small folk who keep home fires burning even and safe.

title: The Tide-Goblins
description: Justin's original shore-folk: goblins who read the tides and warn fishermen of weather.

title: The Star-Goblins
description: Justin's original sky-watchers: tiny astronomers who polish the stars and chart their courses.

title: The Bridge-Goblins
description: Justin's original toll-keepers: goblins who maintain bridges and charge only a story for crossing.
